name: Österreichische Nationalbibliothek
notes: Crawls the 5 sub-museum landing pages for exhibition links (programm/besuch, excluding vergangene-* archives and wanderausstellung touring shows that aren't in Vienna) plus each museum's kalender page for one-off dated events; recurring bookable tours (Fuehrungen, Baby-Fuehrungen etc.) have no published occurrence date on-site (only an external ticket-shop link) and are skipped rather than guessed. Cross-museum joint events (Lange Nacht, Tag des Denkmals) are cross-listed verbatim under every participating museum's calendar and deduped by (title, start).
